title: Reciprocal Convex Costs for Ratio Matching: Functional-Equation Characterization and Decision Geometry
summary: We study ratio-induced mismatch costs of the form $c(s,o)=J(ι_S(s)/ι_O(o))$, built from positive scale maps $ι_S:S\to(0,\infty)$ and $ι_O:O\to(0,\infty)$ and a penalty $J:(0,\infty)\to[0,\infty)$. Assuming inversion symmetry, strict convexity, normalization $J(1)=0$, and a multiplicative d'Alembert identity, we show that $f(u):=1+J(e^u)$ satisfies the additive d'Alembert equation and hence $J(x)=\cosh(a\log x)-1=\tfrac12(x^a+x^{-a})-1$ for some $a>0$. We then analyze the associated argmin mapping over feasible scale sets: existence under explicit subspace-closedness hypotheses,…
